results.segment: This is your Council Tax demand for the property at 2 Sian Streets, which is in valuation band D. The amount payable for the year is £2,006.04, and your account reference is 863/79402/S.

obligations.deadline: on the first of each month

results.segment: The balance is payable in 10 instalments of £200.60 on the first of each month, as set out in the schedule printed with this notice.
Your first instalment of £200.60 is due within 30 days of 22 February 2026. If you pay by Direct Debit, no action is needed and we will collect on that date.

obligations.ask: Tell the Council if circumstances have changed

results.segment: If your circumstances have changed — for example someone has moved in or out — tell us within 30 days of the date of this letter so your bill can be corrected.
Details of discounts, exemptions and how bands are set are printed on the reverse of this notice.

If you think your property is in the wrong band you can ask the Valuation Office to review it; this notice remains payable while a review is open. Appeals about liability go to the Valuation Tribunal.
